final: SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(address_count * 1.0 / city_count.avg_count) FROM (SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count FROM address GROUP BY city_id) AS city_counts CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(address_count) AS avg_count FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS address_count FROM address GROUP BY city_id)) AS city_count) AS share, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(address_count * 1.0 / avg_count) FROM (SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count FROM address GROUP BY city_id) AS city_counts CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(address_count) AS avg_count FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS address_count FROM address GROUP BY city_id)) AS city_count) AS normalized_share FROM address GROUP BY city_id ORDER BY normalized_share DESC LIMIT 10
